name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with Sol-led selective delegation and task-scoped child validation.

interface.shortDescription: Use the selected primary settings; delegate bounded work to Luna.
interface.longDescription: Start immediately with the user's primary model and effort. The orchestration skill owns internal routing, bounded Luna delegation, risk-based verification, compact evidence, and exception-only Terra or fresh Sol review. Auxiliary profiles retain explicit pins, sandbox checks, fail-closed validation, and compatibility-safe installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to carry out the user's task using their selected primary model and effort. Follow the skill's routing, delegation, safety, and acceptance rules without a startup model confirmation or routine route declaration.
